controls.title: Data Protection Impact Assessment (DPIA) Process
controls.description: Conduct DPIAs for high-risk processing activities as required by GDPR Article 35

controls.title: Data Protection Officer (DPO) Appointment
controls.description: Appoint a DPO when required by GDPR Article 37 (public authorities, large-scale processing, special categories)

controls.title: Privacy Notice Compliance
controls.description: Provide clear, concise privacy notices meeting GDPR Article 13/14 requirements

controls.title: Consent Management System
controls.description: Implement system to record, track, and manage consent with withdrawal capability

controls.title: Data Subject Rights Portal
controls.description: Provide accessible mechanism for data subjects to exercise their rights (Articles 15-22)

controls.title: 72-Hour Breach Notification Process
controls.description: Establish process to notify supervisory authority within 72 hours of breach discovery (Article 33)

controls.title: Data Subject Notification Process
controls.description: Process to notify data subjects of high-risk breaches without undue delay (Article 34)

controls.title: Records of Processing Activities (ROPA)
controls.description: Maintain comprehensive records of processing activities as per GDPR Article 30

controls.title: Data Processing Agreement (DPA) Management
controls.description: Ensure all processors have signed DPAs meeting GDPR Article 28 requirements

controls.title: Third Country Transfer Safeguards
controls.description: Implement appropriate safeguards for transfers to third countries (Articles 44-49)

controls.title: Data Minimization by Default
controls.description: Implement technical and organizational measures to ensure data minimization by default

controls.title: Automated Decision-Making Safeguards
controls.description: Implement safeguards for automated decision-making including profiling (Article 22)

controls.title: Data Retention Policy Enforcement
controls.description: Automated enforcement of data retention policies and secure deletion

controls.title: Privacy Training Program
controls.description: Regular privacy training for all personnel handling personal data

controls.title: Vendor Risk Assessment Process
controls.description: Regular assessment of third-party processors for compliance and security
